title: UNIMADE Bulk Washcloths - 100 Pack White Microfiber Face Towels, 12"x12"
verdict: Experience professional-grade softness and unbeatable value with this ultra-plush, fast-drying 100-piece washcloth set, perfect for daily skincare, guest use, or salon services.
pros: Unbeatable Bulk Value: Instantly restock your entire home, salon, or facility with 100 premium washcloths for one low cost.  Superior Softness & Absorbency: Advanced microfiber weave feels exceptionally gentle on sensitive skin while providing maximum water absorption.  Fast-Drying & Sanitary: Dries significantly faster than standard cotton cloths, inhibiting odor and bacterial growth.  Multi-Purpose Durability: Withstands hundreds of wash cycles, making them ideal for facials, makeup removal, gym use, or general cleaning.  Consistent Professional Look: Uniform white design ensures a clean, hygienic appearance for spas, hotels, and Airbnb properties.
cons: Initial Shedding (Minimal): Some lint may occur during the very first wash; we recommend a pre-use gentle cycle.  Heat Sensitivity: Microfiber can be damaged by high-heat dryers; requires low-tumble drying.  Lightweight Feel: Those accustomed to heavy, thick terry may find these slightly thinner, though this aids the rapid-dry feature.
